after_metrics.screened_variants: All day-5/day-10 weak+T1-negative variants had zero triggered trades and zero PnL delta.

change_summary: Added an audit-only script that reruns the current accepted stack, computes day-5/day-10 weak-hold checkpoints, and matches each checkpoint to same-ticker T1-negative news within +/- 3 calendar days using the existing clean_trade_news archive and news_replay classifier. No production strategy code was changed.

delta_metrics.decision_basis: The experiment could not evaluate alpha because lifecycle news coverage was effectively absent at the relevant checkpoints: mid/old coverage 0%, late average lookaround coverage 11.69%, and zero T1-negative checkpoint matches.

hypothesis: Price-only weak-hold exits were rejected because weak starts can become large winners. A stronger lifecycle signal may require both early price weakness and fresh adverse information, specifically T1-negative news near the weak checkpoint.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: This branch is news-dependent but not LLM-dependent. Existing deterministic T1-negative classifier had no usable lifecycle matches; LLM semantic judgment cannot be assessed without archived candidate/news context.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull with limited late news archive coverage
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull with no checkpoint news archive coverage
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape with no checkpoint news archive coverage

next_retry_requires: Collect or construct clean_trade_news coverage for held tickers across entry-to-exit lifecycle checkpoints
Do not rerun news-confirmed weak-hold exits on the same sparse archive
Until lifecycle news coverage exists, pivot alpha search to deterministic non-news sources
notes: This was alpha_search that surfaced a concrete measurement/data coverage blocker. It did not change production strategy code.

parameters.news_confirmation: ticker has T1-negative news in clean_trade_news_YYYYMMDD.json within +/- 3 calendar days

rejection_reason: Not promoted because no variant triggered. Not treated as alpha rejection because the historical archive lacks coverage at held-position checkpoints.
